gloss: in top form; at one's peak; on a roll

definitions.gloss: in top form; at one's peak; in perfect condition
definitions.explanation: A state of performing or feeling at one's absolute best. Used for people, teams, businesses, or anything that can be described as being in excellent condition.

examples.japanese: {今日|きょう}は{絶好調|ぜっこうちょう}だ。
あの{選手|せんしゅ}は{最近|さいきん}{絶好調|ぜっこうちょう}で、{三試合|さんしあい}{連続|れんぞく}ゴールを{決|き}めた。
examples.english: That player has been in top form lately, scoring in three consecutive matches.

examples.japanese: {売|う}り{上|あ}げが{絶好調|ぜっこうちょう}で、{過去|かこ}{最高|さいこう}の{利益|りえき}を{記録|きろく}した。
examples.english: Sales were at their peak, and we recorded our highest profit ever.

notes:
{絶好調|ぜっこうちょう} is formed from {絶|ぜつ} (extreme) + {好調|こうちょう} (good condition). It intensifies {好調|こうちょう} to mean the very best possible condition.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {絶好調|ぜっこうちょう}だ (to be in top form)
- {絶好調|ぜっこうちょう}を{維持|いじ}する (to maintain peak performance)
- {絶好調|ぜっこうちょう}の{選手|せんしゅ} (a player in top form)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {好調|こうちょう}: going well, in good shape — less intense, more neutral
- {絶不調|ぜつふちょう}: in terrible form — the opposite, meaning at one's worst
